KaTeX companion extension "mhchem" - licence and provenance
===========================================================

File in this directory: katex-mhchem.min.js

Origin
------
Taken verbatim from the npm package katex@0.16.22, path dist/contrib/mhchem.min.js
(33,712 bytes). vendor/katex.min.js and css/katex.min.css come from the same package
and the same version, so the extension matches the formula engine exactly.

The extension bundles the mhchem syntax implementation version 3.3.0 by Martin Hensel
(https://mhchem.github.io/MathJax-mhchem/), adapted for KaTeX.

Licence
-------
Distributed as part of KaTeX under the MIT licence; the full text is in
vendor/LICENSE-katex.txt (Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Khan Academy and other contributors,
plus the mhchem authors). The upstream package ships no separate licence file for this
artifact.

Loading requirements (MarkView)
-------------------------------
The script registers \ce (and \pu) into the KaTeX instance that already exists on the
page, so it MUST be loaded after vendor/katex.min.js and before the viewer script starts
rendering formulas - see the <script> order in index.html.
